Curug Ibun Pelangi, Majalengka, East Java, is a combination of a waterfall and a river that flows between 2 high cliffs.

It was named Ibun Pelang or Embun Pelangi means "Rainbow Dew" because the dew from the waterfall that falls are exposed to sunlight, so that the rainbow light can appear around the waterfall.

It is an exotic sight for tourism and photography. The best time to visit is early in the morning when the sun just rises.
